scope: Private host-side replay of the on-device fuel planner against the immutable NS pack; no phone install and no live/server request.
decision: Keep 1dc7f8b as the private candidate. Do not install to white yet. The on-device fuel window now commits one proven next pump and continues from that pump; the simulator probe is the remaining internal gate before a device run.
correctness_note: The planner proves each selected station with a profile route and continuation. The strict NativeFuelContinuity audit still reports unverified 26-34 m pump approach geometry and source-walk mismatches; this remains a qualification item and is not being hidden by the speed result.
recovery: Do not install to white from an older checkpoint. Build 1dc7f8b or newer from the private branch; keep production and published packs unchanged.

routeReuse.qualification: This verifies the client reuse path with a scripted pack source. Real-pack strict NativeFuelContinuity still has the documented pump-approach/source-walk qualification.

currentSourceReplay.scope: Current captured PackRoutingSource replay against the same immutable NS pack; macOS host facade, not phone qualification.

endpointKindReplay.change: Rejected trial: attempted to mark pack pump profile searches with customer endpoint semantics.
endpointKindReplay.strictAudit: unchanged incomplete; pump approach remains unverified at 34.3 m and 26.8 m, with the same source-walk qualification errors.
endpointKindReplay.decision: Rejected: the endpoint arguments are not consumed by the native router yet, so the trial was behaviorally a no-op. Do not carry dead plumbing into the device candidate.

fastOnDeviceCandidate.change: Pack fuel planning now treats the waypoint only as a forward-direction guide. For partial windows it selects the nearest useful forward station in the departure pack, proves and returns only the start-to-pump route, and starts the next window from that pump. It no longer requires an A→pump→destination continuation before committing a normal station. All profiles use the bounded path; cross-region seams use limited fast attempts, nearby hops use a compact corridor, and progress text presents finding the next stop and routing to it.

hostFixture.searchMode: one Dirt corridor, no repair ladder, 1.8s absolute cutoff
hostFixture.scope: macOS native facade using the current OnDeviceRouter source; not physical-phone qualification

fastOnDeviceCandidate.errorContract: Returns fuel_fast_path_no_qualified_route with windowComplete=false only when no legal next station hop is proven; this is a station-hop failure, not evidence that the pack has no fuel stations.
fastOnDeviceCandidate.correctnessGate: Each returned first hop is a profile route with legal snapping/turn checks, bounded by the candidate-specific cap inside the rider range, and rejected when the mapped forecourt is more than 150m from the returned road endpoint. The next window must prove the following hop. Strict source-walk fuel continuity still remains required for the soft station connector.

routeVariance.result: three distinct Dirt geometries for identical endpoints; fresh pin builds also receive distinct seeds and saved routes remain reproducible

focusedGate.scope: PackFirstRoutingTests + ItineraryBuilderTests + ItineraryRebuildTests; includes identical-pin fresh-seed assertion

fastOnDeviceCandidate.limitation: The partial station connector remains labelled soft-stitch until customer-access edges are authored and the strict source-walk audit accepts it. The simulator NS→NB probe is successful for all three profiles as a partial pump window, but current cold-profile timings are Cleanest 1.63s, Dirt 2.27s, Balanced 2.62s; no physical-device run has been made.

concurrency.interpretation: Single-process and four-way host runs meet the 1.8s cutoff. Eight-way contention on one Mac exceeds it while each process remains under 95 MiB RSS; this is CPU contention, not graph-memory growth.

simulatorProbe.result: All three profiles returned a proven first pump without destination continuation; Dirt and Balanced remain above the 2s target.

crossRegionFastPath.scope: Private simulator pack replay only; no physical-device run and no live/server request.
crossRegionFastPath.guard: Requires both endpoint packs and factory-proven seams; partial windows commit only a proven next pump and return windowComplete=false.

directRouteGate.scope: PackRoutingSource direct on-device requests; no route or error may remain inside the old seven-second Dirt candidate cap
